sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By using the Dayni platform, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to any part of them, please do not use the service. We may modify these terms at any time, and you will be notified of any material changes via email or through the platform.

sections.title: 2. Description of the Service
sections.body: Dayni is a cloud platform for managing customer debts, enabling small shop and store owners to record debts and payments and track customer balances. We offer this service through three subscription plans — Free, Basic, and Pro — each with its own features and limits.

sections.title: 3. User Account
items: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account.
You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.
You must provide accurate, up-to-date information when registering and update it as needed.
You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
We may suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.intro: You agree not to use the platform for any of the following:
items: Violating any applicable laws or regulations in Saudi Arabia.
Publishing misleading, fraudulent, or abusive content.
Attempting to hack or disrupt the platform's servers or databases.
Reselling, renting, or licensing the service to third parties without explicit permission.
Using automated tools to access data without authorization.

sections.title: 5. Subscriptions and Payments
items: Paid subscriptions renew automatically each month until cancelled.
You may cancel your subscription at any time from the subscription management page.
Upon cancellation, paid plan features remain available until the end of the current period.
We reserve the right to change prices with at least 30 days' prior notice.
All payments are processed securely through trusted payment gateways.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content, designs, logos, and source code used on the Dayni platform are the exclusive property of ours or our licensors. You are not granted any license to use this intellectual property outside the platform's normal use. Your data and your customers' data always remain your property.

sections.title: 7. Disclaimer
sections.body: The service is provided "as is" without any express or implied warranties. We are not liable for any losses or damages arising from use or inability to use the service. We always strive to ensure the service's availability and security, but we do not guarantee this at all times.

sections.title: 8. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws and regulations of Saudi Arabia. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with applicable Saudi regulations.

sections.title: 9. Contact Us
sections.body: For any questions about these terms, please reach out at support@dayni.app

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: At Dayni, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use our platform.
privacyPage.dataAccountBody: Name, email, shop name, and encrypted password.
privacyPage.dataUsageBody: Customer, invoice, and payment data that you enter into the platform.
privacyPage.dataTechBody: IP address, browser type, device used, and access times.

sections.title: 2. How we use your data
items: Operating the service and providing you with its features.
Sending notifications and reminders related to your account.
Improving the user experience and developing new features.
Processing payments and subscriptions.
Providing technical support when needed.
Complying with legal and regulatory requirements.

sections.title: 3. Data sharing
sections.intro: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We may share limited data only in the following cases:
items: Service providers: such as payment processors and cloud hosting providers, who are obligated to protect your data.
Legal requirements: if required to do so by law or a court order.
Protecting rights: to protect our rights or the rights of our users from fraud or harm.

sections.title: 4. Data security
sections.intro: We use the latest encryption and protection technologies to keep your data secure:
items: SSL/TLS encryption for all data in transit.
Passwords encrypted with the bcrypt algorithm.
Databases protected within secure cloud environments.
Regular data backups.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies to run sessions and improve the experience. We do not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes. You can manage cookie settings from your browser.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Correct or update your inaccurate data.
Request deletion of your account and data.
Export your data (available on paid plans).
Unsubscribe from marketing messages.
sections.outro: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@dayni.app

sections.title: 7. Data retention
sections.body: We retain your data as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, your data is deleted within 30 days unless there are legal requirements to retain it longer.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to update this policy. You'll be notified of any material changes via email or a prominent notice on the platform at least 30 days before they take effect.

sections.title: 9. Contact us
sections.body: For any questions or concerns about your privacy: support@dayni.app

refundPage.title: Refund Policy
refundPage.commitment: At Dayni, we strive for your complete satisfaction. If you're not happy with our service, we're here to help find the right solution.
refundPage.acceptedIntro: You may request a refund in the following cases:
refundPage.case1Title: ✅ Within 7 days of your first subscription
refundPage.case2Body: If the service is completely unavailable for more than 48 continuous hours, you're entitled to claim a prorated refund.
refundPage.case3Body: If a duplicate or incorrect amount was charged, we refund the difference immediately.
refundPage.cancelBody: Prevents renewal in the next billing cycle. Your current plan's features remain available until the end of the paid period.
refundPage.refundBody: Means returning the amount paid and stopping the service immediately, subject to the specific conditions listed above.
refundPage.step1Body: Email support@dayni.app or use the support page.
refundPage.step2Body: State your account email, the reason for the refund request, and the payment date.
refundPage.step3Body: We'll review your request and respond within 2-3 business days.
refundPage.step4Body: The amount is refunded to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

sections.title: 1. Money-back guarantee
sections.body: We offer a full money-back guarantee within 7 days of your first paid subscription. If you're not satisfied with the service for any reason during this period, just contact us and we'll refund you in full, no questions asked.

sections.title: 3. Cases where refunds don't apply
items: After the 7-day window for renewing subscriptions.
Subscriptions where the service was used extensively (more than 50 operations).
Accounts disabled for violating the terms of service.
Fees relating to a subscription period that has already passed.

sections.title: 6. Refund methods
items: The same credit or debit card used for payment.
Direct bank transfer if payment was made by transfer.
Refunds typically take 5 to 10 business days to appear in your account.

sections.title: 7. Questions
sections.body: If you have any questions about our refund policy, feel free to reach out: support@dayni.app. We respond to all inquiries within 24 hours on business days.
